timing: Before the independent sampler is run; complete observed channel integrals and branching fits are still pending.
algorithm: Independent random-walk Metropolis in four log-ratios, with the exact simplex Jacobian. Finite-difference Hessian at a numerically optimized transformed mode sets proposal covariance. Adapt only a common proposal scale during warmup, then freeze. All samples retained for convergence checks; no chain selection.
calibration: Known69 assignments35CE/34SMT at equal efficiencies give Dirichlet(36,1,1,1,35).
failure_policy: Save every failed gate with hashes. Do not select chains or relax thresholds to declare agreement.
limits: Independent posterior computation under saved event/selection integrals. These diagnostics do not certify PE-chain, injection-campaign or astrophysical validity.
